authority.rule: The firmware GATT declaration owns UUID allocation, GATT properties, and wire layout. This contract records the supported surface so host consumers can be checked offline.

characteristics.payload: u32 little-endian frame counter followed by N samples of red, IR, green u32 little-endian values; 4 + 12*N bytes
u32 little-endian frame counter followed by N X/Y/Z Int16 little-endian samples; 4 + 6*N bytes
current firmware sends sizeof(tgm_service_temp_data_t): u32 frame counter plus Int16 centi-degrees, with implementation padding represented in host parsers
device identifier as supplied by firmware
PPG register read request/result; not a battery characteristic
PPG register write request/result; not a battery characteristic
five bytes: on_dock, worn, device_state, battery_pct, charge_active
versioned firmware configuration and bench-state bytes
eight little-endian bytes: voltage_mv u16, gauge u8, flags u8, mAh_used_x100 u16, minutes_left u16; 0xFFFF minutes means on case or budget unavailable

legacy_symbol.meaning: Historical host-side name for temperature UUID 3A0FF003. Keep only as a deprecated alias while clients migrate to temperatureCharUUID. It is not a firmware command characteristic.

unsupported_in_current_firmware.reason: Not declared by the current firmware TGM service. Do not subscribe to it in the supported logging or release path.

change_policy: Allocate or alter a UUID only in a versioned contract change reviewed with the firmware owner.
Update the firmware declaration, Core constants, iOS client, Python tools, captured fixtures, and this contract in one compatibility change.
Do not reinterpret 3A0FF007 or 3A0FF008 as battery telemetry.
For a breaking payload change, add a new characteristic or a documented versioned payload; do not silently reuse an existing UUID.
